installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
TMP_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.loxy-mta-install"

cleanup() {
    rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}" "${SERVER_DIR}"

echo "=================================================="
echo "        MTA Installer - Loxy Systems v2"
echo "=================================================="

echo "[1/6] Preparando dependencias do instalador..."
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    tar \
    unzip
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

cd "${TMP_DIR}"

echo "[2/6] Baixando MTA Server..."
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o multitheftauto_linux_x64.tar.gz \
    "https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/multitheftauto_linux_x64.tar.gz"

echo "[3/6] Baixando configuracao base..."
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o mta-baseconfig.tar.gz \
    "https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/baseconfig.tar.gz"

echo "[4/6] Baixando resources oficiais..."
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o mtasa-resources-latest.zip \
    "https://mirror.multitheftauto.com/mtasa/resources/mtasa-resources-latest.zip"

echo "[5/6] Extraindo e instalando sem sobrescrever arquivos existentes..."

mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}/server-extract" "${TMP_DIR}/config-extract"

tar -xzf multitheftauto_linux_x64.tar.gz -C "${TMP_DIR}/server-extract"

MTA_BINARY="$(find "${TMP_DIR}/server-extract" -type f -name mta-server64 -print -quit || true)"
if [[ -z "${MTA_BINARY}" ]]; then
    echo "[ERRO] Pacote do MTA nao contem mta-server64."
    exit 1
fi

MTA_ROOT="$(dirname "${MTA_BINARY}")"
cp -a -n "${MTA_ROOT}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/mods/deathmatch/resources"

# Resources: preserva arquivos existentes do cliente.
unzip -nq mtasa-resources-latest.zip -d "${SERVER_DIR}/mods/deathmatch/resources" || true

tar -xzf mta-baseconfig.tar.gz -C "${TMP_DIR}/config-extract"

if [[ -d "${TMP_DIR}/config-extract/baseconfig" ]]; then
    cp -a -n "${TMP_DIR}/config-extract/baseconfig/." "${SERVER_DIR}/mods/deathmatch/"
else
    BASE_ROOT="$(find "${TMP_DIR}/config-extract" -type f -name mtaserver.conf -print -quit || true)"
    if [[ -n "${BASE_ROOT}" ]]; then
        cp -a -n "$(dirname "${BASE_ROOT}")/." "${SERVER_DIR}/mods/deathmatch/"
    fi
fi

# Compatibilidade com builds/recursos antigos que ainda esperam essa biblioteca.
if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16" ]]; then
    echo "[MYSQL] libmysqlclient.so.16 ausente. Tentando baixar compatibilidade..."
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
        "https://nightly.mtasa.com/files/libmysqlclient.so.16" \
        -o "${SERVER_DIR}/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16" \
        || rm -f "${SERVER_DIR}/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16"
fi

echo "[6/6] Ajustando permissoes..."

chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/mta-server64"
[[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/mta-server" ]] && chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/mta-server"
[[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/mta-accelerator" ]] && chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/mta-accelerator"

find "${SERVER_DIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.so*" -exec chmod 644 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=================================================="
echo " Instalacao concluida."
echo " Runtime: ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:mta"
echo " Startup remoto: LoxyHosting/loxy-game-eggs/mta.sh"
echo " Arquivos existentes do cliente foram preservados."
echo "=================================================="
